nodes.label: Follow Honorbuddy Parity Rule
nodes.rationale: Fixes must reproduce original Honorbuddy behavior (3.3.5a first, then 4.3.4 or 5.x/6.x) and cite the HB version and method so the port does not diverge from HB semantics.

nodes.label: In-Game 3.3.5a Verification and Log Rule
nodes.rationale: Requires live 3.3.5a server testing with before/after logs from the Logs folder because static builds alone cannot validate game-client behavior.

nodes.label: No New Code Comments Policy
nodes.rationale: Only original Honorbuddy comments are kept in the codebase.

nodes.label: Runtime-Compiled Caller Compatibility Rule
nodes.rationale: Bots, plugins, routines, quest behaviors, and dungeon scripts in bin are compiled at runtime, so public method changes must be checked across all runtime callers.
